purpose: Tenant rider and facility lookup without cross-tenant inference
sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('rider',(SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM intake.rider r WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.synthetic_reference=$2),'facility',(SELECT to_jsonb(f) FROM intake.facility f WHERE f.tenant_id=$1 AND f.synthetic_label=$3)) AS result
SELECT id, planned_start_at, planned_end_at, lifecycle_reference, aggregate_version FROM dispatch.run WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND service_date=$2 ORDER BY planned_start_at LIMIT 100

purpose: Trip legs not on a run
sql: SELECT l.id, l.planned_start_at FROM intake.trip_leg l LEFT JOIN dispatch.run_leg rl ON rl.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND rl.trip_leg_id=l.id WHERE l.tenant_id=$1 AND l.planned_start_at >= $2 AND l.planned_start_at < $3 AND rl.id IS NULL ORDER BY l.planned_start_at LIMIT 100
SELECT rl.id, rl.trip_leg_id, rl.ordinal FROM dispatch.run_leg rl WHERE rl.tenant_id=$1 AND rl.run_id=$2 ORDER BY rl.ordinal
SELECT run_id FROM dispatch.resource_reservation WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND resource_kind=$2 AND resource_id=$3 AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND occupied_during && $4::tstzrange LIMIT 10

purpose: Meter-radius lookup over newest vehicle projections
sql: SELECT subject_id, captured_at FROM realtime.current_position WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND subject_kind='vehicle' AND ST_DWithin(position,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($2,$3),4326)::geography,$4) ORDER BY captured_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM intake.service_area WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND ST_Covers(boundary,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($2,$3),4326)) LIMIT 10

SELECT stream_epoch, sequence_number, captured_at, ST_X(position::geometry) AS longitude, ST_Y(position::geometry) AS latitude FROM realtime.current_position WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND subject_kind=$2 AND subject_id=$3 AND device_id=$4
SELECT captured_at, sequence_number FROM realtime.location_breadcrumb WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND device_id=$2 AND recorded_at >= $3 AND recorded_at < $4 ORDER BY captured_at DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT aggregate_version, action_reference, occurred_at FROM audit.event WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND aggregate_kind=$2 AND aggregate_id=$3 ORDER BY aggregate_version

purpose: Billing cases explicitly carrying the ready lifecycle reference
sql: SELECT id, trip_request_id, aggregate_version FROM billing.billing_case WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND lifecycle_reference='ready' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100
SELECT id, request_fingerprint FROM integration.receipt WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND source_reference=$2
SELECT request_fingerprint, result_reference FROM platform.idempotency_record WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND operation_key=$2
UPDATE dispatch.run SET aggregate_version=aggregate_version+1, updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND aggregate_version=$3 RETURNING aggregate_version
